title: DevOps, Platform and SRE results
lede: Eligibility is checked before technical scoring. "Able to Sponsor" is treated as a lead requiring confirmation that TN work authorization is supported.

ineligible.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
ineligible.reason: On-site in Armonk, NY with no remote option stated (contradicts the workplaceTypes=Remote search filter); also an LLM/RAG/prompt-engineering AI-application role, not infrastructure/DevOps.

rows.title: DevOps Engineer (content reads as SRE)
rows.location: Remote in Kansas City, KS, US area — on-site "depends on experience"
rows.gap: None material — strong direct overlap (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS/Azure, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub Actions, incident response/runbooks). Flag: "Able to Sponsor", W-2 only, explicitly "No C2C" — TN-sponsorship path, confirm remote-from-Canada support with recruiter before pursuing.

rows.title: DevOps Engineer
rows.location: Remote (Columbus OH / Chicago IL / Minneapolis MN / Detroit MI / Madison WI rotation) — on-site "depends on experience"
rows.gap: Security-scanning tooling (SonarQube, Snyk, Prisma Cloud, Checkmarx) is new but adjacent to existing CI/CD and observability work. Flag: "Able to Sponsor", W-2 only, explicitly "No C2C" — TN-sponsorship path, confirm remote-from-Canada support.

rows.title: Salesforce DevOps Architect
rows.gap: Requires hands-on Flosum, Copado, or Gearset (Marc's real Salesforce delivery work at Énergir used native Salesforce CLI plus a custom validation pipeline, not these commercial release-management tools) and some Apex/LWC/Health Cloud/Experience Cloud development depth Marc doesn't have. Posting also references IL4/IL5 federal compliance environments as a plus — confirm how hard that requirement actually is. Flag: "Able to Sponsor" on an FTE role — confirm authorization path.

rows.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
rows.gap: Requires Go programming proficiency, which Marc doesn't have. Flag: USD-denominated salary and no sponsorship language anywhere in the posting — likely a US-only role; confirm Canada/remote-international eligibility with the recruiter before pursuing.

rows.title: Migration Solution Architect – Azure
rows.gap: Requires 8–12+ years specifically in a Solution Architect title/scope; Marc's architecture-adjacent work is real but not formally titled at this tenure (profile deliberately avoids leading with "Architect" framing for this reason). Strong Azure/AWS/Terraform/DevSecOps overlap otherwise. Flag: no sponsorship/clearance language stated — confirm Canada eligibility before pursuing given the high US-typical salary band.

rows.title: RH OpenShift Container Platform 4 – Platform Deployment Senior Consultant
rows.salary: Depends on Experience; Contract W-2, 4 months
rows.gap: Requires 4+ years of hands-on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.x administration specifically (IPI/UPI cluster installs, OVN-Kubernetes, RBAC/SCC) — Marc's Kubernetes/ArgoCD work at Desjardins is real but not OpenShift-specific. Flag: no sponsorship/authorization language stated — confirm Canada eligibility.

rows.title: Senior DevOps / Data Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Real AWS/Terraform/CI-CD overlap, but the role's actual center of gravity is data-platform engineering (Snowflake, Parquet/S3 data lake patterns, Fivetran CDC, database replication) rather than core infrastructure DevOps — the profile's scope rule excludes data-engineering-centered roles even when infra keywords are present. A different GlobalLogic posting was rejected 2026-07-07 (score 4, multi-cloud lead scope gap) — same employer, consistent pattern.

rows.title: AWS Cloud Migration Architect
rows.gap: Hard-gated: AWS migration-architecture ownership at scale is literally the deliverable (Migration Hub, MGN, Landing Zone, Control Tower, 10+ years) — this exceeds what the ~6-month, non-production, by-hand Tink AWS build supports per the profile's AWS/GCP hard-gate rule. Capped regardless of the genuinely Canada-open arrangement.

rows.gap: OpenShift/certificate/ServiceNow overlap is real but the role reads as app-support/platform-ops hybrid (ongoing Java/.NET maintenance), not pure platform engineering; W-2 only, Canada/TN eligibility unconfirmed.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions — not opened for full validation
items: 22 of the 32 unique postings reviewed were screened out by title alone as off-topic for the SRE/Platform/DevOps family, per the skill's skim-before-fetch guidance: 2× Business Analyst, 2× Quality Assurance Engineer, 5× Salesforce Developer/Architect/Tech Lead (non-DevOps app-dev flavor), 3× Oracle Cloud/EPM/Fusion functional consultant, 1× SAP Commerce Solutions Architect, 1× Cloud Security analyst role, 1× Senior Google Cloud Architect (GCP-primary — would hit the GCP hard gate on sight), and 5× AI/Generative-AI-flavored roles (Senior AI Agent Platform Engineer, AI Platform Engineer, Principal Generative AI Engineer, and two more Forward Deployed Engineer postings centered on LLM/RAG/agentic-AI work rather than infrastructure).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: All six default titles were searched (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer); up to 8 results reviewed per query, deduplicated to 32 unique postings by Dice job GUID.
Direct HTTP retrieval worked cleanly for both search results and individual job-detail pages this run — no browser fallback needed.

"Able to Sponsor" appears on several postings without naming TN specifically — flagged per-posting for recruiter confirmation rather than assumed eligible, per the skill's TN-sponsorship-path rule. Several roles carry no sponsorship/authorization language at all rather than an explicit unsponsored-authorization-required statement, so per the eligibility gate's ordering they were scored with a confirm-authorization flag rather than excluded outright.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
